repositoryReach.interpretation: The project has little public reach telemetry and published releases have no downloadable assets. These facts reduce the observable migration population but do not measure private or source-based consumers.

implementationBoundary.remainingPresetValue: A short compatibility selector that supplies explicit/eager/error/strict-on defaults, plus stable report labels and build-lane names.

siblings.verdict: Retains a true global portable/metal contract because ownership, nullability, native APIs, and fail-closed no-hxrt eligibility still carry irreducible target-wide semantics.
Uses one pipeline and source/API-scoped authoring intent; it has no application-wide semantic backend switch, and strictness remains orthogonal.
Keeps its existing public portable/ruby_first compatibility contract because renaming churn has no current payoff, while rejecting a generic metal/performance profile without irreducible semantics.

conclusion: The Go selector no longer owns semantics, but its shorthand and compatibility value are real. Public-search absence is insufficient removal evidence; retain it without a warning and require a later evidence-backed decision before reconsideration.
